Basal metabolic rate

Source: R/utils.R
met_basal.Rd

Calculate basal metabolism from rest test data using a rolling window to identify the most metabolically stable 5-minute period.

Usage

met_basal(
  step_time,
  db,
  cv_var,
  window_duration = 300,
  author = "Frayn",
  energy_equivalents = "classic"
)

Arguments

step_time

how often the data was collected (in seconds).

db

a data frame with columns VO2, VCO2, RER, HR.

cv_var

variable to calculate coefficient of variation: "VO2", "VCO2" or "RER".

window_duration

duration of the stable window in seconds (default 300 = 5 min).

author

equation set used for resting substrate oxidation: "Frayn" (default), "Jeukendrup" or "Peronnet". `MFO()` passes its own `author`, so resting and exercise values use the same equations (SPEC 9.5). Jeukendrup & Wallis (2005) propose no resting equation; with "Jeukendrup" the package uses the 100 % glucose pair derived from their Table 4 (see [substrate_oxidation()], `phase = "rest"`).

energy_equivalents

"classic" (default) or "source"; see [substrate_oxidation()].
